arguments.text: Long race. Settle to race pace now, smooth and long.

10 km, 1000 m out-and-back legs, current+wind flip each leg. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod ~175 W shaft / boat ~112 W per pre-race test, may be 10-25% off), a touch more effort on legs against the current. Calibrate CP from heart rate (levels off below CP, climbs above) and measure() on paired legs. Watch pod-vs-boat power ratio for weed (boat slows at same pod power/HR -> clear_rudder) or pod drift (pod changes, boat speed and HR do not -> set pod_gain). Finish sprint sized to the reserve in the last ~500 m. Save cues (20 max).

arguments.name: pod_boat_ratio
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-model power; jumps with weed, pod drift or an unfitted current/wind

arguments.text: t=60s: start hot, pod 252 W vs CP 174 (145%), boat 168 vs 112, HR 155 and rising, reserve pod 60%. Cued ease (no pace target). pod/boat ratio ~1.5 at start. push_along -0.27 on leg 1 (north).

arguments.reason: check the ease cue took and where effort settled

text: Cued ease: paddler at 145% of critical power one minute in, reserve draining; set plan, ratio metric, wake in 70 s.

arguments.message: pod/boat power ratio high: weed/drag, pod reading high, or unfitted current
pod/boat power ratio low: pod reading low or new tailwind/current

arguments.text: t=141s: after ease cue pod 189 W (109% CP), boat 122, rate 58, HR 170 still rising (start lag). Pod reserve 45% (start spent half). Paddler says 6/10 plenty (evidence only). Watches: ratio_high >1.8, ratio_low <1.3, reserve_low <0.2. Baseline pod/boat ratio ~1.5-1.55. Idea: pace target ~165 s/500 over ground given at CP effort gives ~+12% into current/-15% with it, near optimal split.

arguments.reason: HR trend at settled effort: levels off or keeps climbing?

text: no cue: effort 109% of CP just after the ease, waiting for heart-rate trend
no cue: effort 109% of critical power just after the ease; waiting for the heart-rate trend.

arguments.text: t=269s leg1 (against current): measure 150-268s pod 190 W (109% pod CP), boat 117 W, GPS 2.87, rate 58, HR 172.6 trend +1.24+-0.31 bpm/min -> mild climb, consistent with CP near/below 190. Pod reserve 27% (drains ~8%/min at 190). Pod/boat ratio crept 1.5 -> 1.65-1.69 (watch: pod drift up? or push fit lag: push_along -0.21 vs local -0.26). Plan: ease after turn (with-current leg, refill reserve), let it fade back up on the next against leg.

arguments.reason: just after turn 1: cue ease for the with-current leg

text: no cue: 9% over critical power on the against-current leg is acceptable; will ease after the turn.

arguments.text: Through the turn, ease off. Recover with the current this leg.

arguments.reason: check ease after turn 1: effort on with-current leg, reserve refilling

text: Cued ease at the first turn: pod reserve 17% and draining; the with-current leg is the cheap place to recover.

arguments.text: Reserve nearly gone. Ease to 2:34 pace, let it refill.

t=427s leg2 (with current, push +0.26): paddler did NOT follow turn ease (pod 197->188). Pod reserve 4%, boat reserve 32% (disagree: pod/boat ratio was 1.63-1.69 on leg1 vs 1.56 now, CP ratio 1.555). HR 171->178 over 5 min (+1.5/min) at pod 188-197 = above CP. Cued ease with ground pace target 154 s/500 (~165 W pod). MUST re-cue before turn 2 (remaining 8000): a ground target into the current would push effort up to +12%.

arguments.reason: did the paddler ease to the 2:34 target?
before turn 2: replace the 2:34 ground pace target (it would overdrive into the current)

text: Cued ease with a 2:34 ground pace target: pod reserve 4% and heart rate still climbing; turn ease was not followed.

arguments.text: Test piece: four minutes a touch easier, then back to race pace.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: ~13 kJ done above 174 W by t=490 s (pre-race reserve 12 kJ) with no forced slowdown -> CP above 174 or reserve bigger; HR still climbing +1.5/min at 192 W and +1.0/min at 187 W -> CP below ~187

arguments.text: t=491s: paddler ignored 2 ease cues + the 2:34 target, says feeling great, going. measure: hull share 0.64 (0.634-0.644), push out-dir -0.266. HR trend +1.53/min at pod 192 (leg1), +0.97/min at 187 (leg2). EXPERIMENT: piece -8% x 240 s (~172 W) from t~495 to ~740: HR trend at lower effort; zero crossing of HR trend vs pod power ~= CP. test_cost said ~0 s net.

arguments.reason: end of test piece: measure HR trend in last 150 s of the piece vs 187-192 W stretches

text: Cued a 4-minute -8% test piece: eases a paddler who ignores ease cues and measures the heart-rate trend at a lower effort to bracket critical power.

arguments.text: t=671s: piece (-8%) only partly followed: pod 187 -> 180. HR trend at 180 W (540-630s): +0.87+-0.39/min vs +0.97 at 187 -> still climbing at 180, so CP likely <=180; no crash after 13+ kJ above 174 -> reserve bigger than 12 kJ or CP ~176-180. Reserve probably low. Pod/boat share 0.62-0.64 matches pre-race 0.644: no pod drift. Leg 3 start: GPS low (turn in 30-s mean) - recheck push_local vs leg 1 (-0.25) for weed/new current.

text: no cue: test piece still running until 755 s; checking heading-into-current speeds after the turn clears.
